recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一大片界線清楚的細胞結節，細胞核卵圓至梭形、細胞質淡而透亮、細胞間有粉紅色纖維化基質，與周圍脂肪髓分隔，符合伴硬化灶的肥大細胞結節（mast cell nodule）。
features: Large compact nodule of monotonous mononuclear cells occupying much of the field amid fat spaces
Round, oval to focally spindled nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale to clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in areas (fried-egg-like appearance)
Intervening eosinophilic fibrillary/collagenous stroma consistent with a sclerotic focus
Few admixed normal hematopoietic cells; granules not discernible on H&E
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large cellular nodule set among adipocytes. The nodule is composed of monotonous mononuclear cells with round to oval and focally spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate pale to clear cytoplasm, separated by eosinophilic fibrillary to collagenous stroma consistent with sclerosis. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is sparse within the lesion, and cytoplasmic granules cannot be resolved on H&E. Findings are consistent with a neoplastic mast cell nodule with associated sclerosis in systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117, and CD25 immunohistochemistry are needed to confirm the multifocal dense aggregates required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Hairy cell leukemia also shows fried-egg cells with clear cytoplasm but grows diffusely and expresses CD20, annexin A1, and BRAF V600E rather than tryptase and CD117.
Lymphoid cells have round nuclei with scant cytoplasm and lack the pale spindled cytoplasm and sclerosis, and they stain with CD3 or CD20.
Granulomas consist of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated slipper-shaped nuclei and often giant cells, and are CD68 positive but tryptase negative.
Myelofibrosis shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes and streaming hematopoiesis in fibrotic stroma rather than a nodule of uniform mast cells.
